title: Not Really What It is Advertised As, but a decent quality frying pan
text: Not Really What It is Advertised As, but a decent quality frying pan. There is a lot of hype about these red copper pans being non-stick and scratch resistant.  Don't believe it.  I have cured the pan a couple of times, according to instructions and while it helps a little, for a while, to prevent sticking, food still sticks and sometimes sticks badly, especially eggs.  In TV commercials they show the eggs sliding around the pan freely.  Maybe if you keep moving the eggs around that would work, but wouldn't it with any pan?  The scratch resistance is hype too, as my pan scratched after just a few uses, although they are minor scratches and don't seem to impact the cooking much.  (I didn't use metal implements either.)  On the plus side, the pan does heat evenly and appears to be able to take high temperatures without warping.  I have been using mine for months and no visible warping.  The pan cleans up without too much scrubbing, even with stuck on food.  The stay cool handle works, sort of.  It stays pretty cool on the part you would normally grab, but don't reach too close to where it hooks on the pan, as it gets hotter, the closer you get to the pan.  You might not burn yourself, but you wouldn't want to hold on for very long.  Also after you cure the pan in the oven, the handle will be too hot to grab, so you have to use a holder and let it cool down.  I wouldn't buy another one of these, as it is only slightly better than an average pan.

product_metadata.title: Red Copper 10 inch Pan by BulbHead Ceramic Copper Infused Non-Stick Fry Pan Skillet Scratch Resistant Without PFOA and PTFE Heat Resistant From Stove To Oven Up To 500 Degrees
features: Copper-infused 10" fry pan includes a high-heat-resistant, PFOA and PTFE-free, scratch-resistant ceramic coating that will not peel, chip, or flake
Naturally non-stick ceramic surface allows you fry up your favorite breakfast meats, eggs, veggies, and more; aluminum cooking rings ensure even heat for no hot spots
Transitions from stovetop to ovens up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit for meal versatility; brown chicken or chops, sear steak, and finish in the oven
Hand wash pan; not dishwasher safe
Season pan with vegetable oil before use (see User Manual) and use soft utensils to prevent from scratching
description: This Red Copper copper-infused ceramic 10" fry pan will be your go-to pan for frying, browning, searing, and more. The stay-cool handle makes it easy to move from stove to table (oven mitt recommended if using Red Copper pan in the oven) and will quickly become your favorite go-to pan. Many brands with non-stick coatings can be unsafe or do not live up to their scratch-resistant promises, but Red Copper ceramic non-scratch coating is free of PFOA and PTFE's, and will not flake or peel. Red Copper cookware includes a sturdy copper-infused aluminum construction which makes it a reliable addition to your cabinets.
